arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 50 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Condition'
  AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%asthma%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%status asthmaticus%')
  AND invalid_reason IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name;

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Visit'
  AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%emergency%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%urgent%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%emerg%')
  AND invalid_reason IS NULL
ORDER BY concept_name;

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Drug'
  AND (LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%prednisone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%prednisolone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%dexamethasone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hydrocortisone%')
  AND invalid_reason IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept='S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, concept_name;

arguments.sql_query: SELECT MAX(visit_start_date) AS max_visit_date, MIN(visit_start_date) AS min_visit_date, COUNT(*) AS visits FROM omop.visit_occurrence;
SELECT MAX(drug_exposure_start_date) AS max_drug_date, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS min_drug_date, COUNT(*) AS drug_exposures FROM omop.drug_exposure;

SELECT TOP 100 route_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM omop.drug_exposure
WHERE route_source_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY route_source_value
ORDER BY n DESC;

SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Drug'
  AND concept_class_id='Ingredient'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('prednisone','prednisolone','dexamethasone','methylprednisolone','hydrocortisone')
ORDER BY concept_name;

SELECT YEAR(visit_start_date) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS visits
FROM omop.visit_occurrence
WHERE visit_start_date >= '2020-01-01' AND visit_start_date < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(visit_start_date)
ORDER BY yr;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT CAST('2023-07-01' AS date) AS start_date, CAST('2026-07-01' AS date) AS end_date
),
asthma_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009 -- SNOMED Asthma
),
exacerbation_concepts AS (
    SELECT concept_id
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE domain_id = 'Condition'
      AND invalid_reason IS NULL
      AND standard_concept = 'S'
      AND (
          LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%exacerbation%asthma%'
          OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%status asthmaticus%'
          OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%acute severe%asthma%'
      )
),
ed_exac AS (
    SELECT
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(v.visit_start_date), MONTH(v.visit_start_date), 1) AS month_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_occurrence_id) AS ed_exacerbation_visits,
        COUNT(DISTINCT v.person_id) AS ed_exacerbation_patients
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
    JOIN params p ON v.visit_start_date >= p.start_date AND v.visit_start_date < p.end_date
    JOIN asthma_patients ap ON ap.person_id = v.person_id
    JOIN omop.person per ON per.person_id = v.person_id
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
      ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
     AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM exacerbation_concepts)
    WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9203, 262, 8870) -- ER, ER+IP, Emergency Room-Hospital
      AND (YEAR(v.visit_start_date) - per.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 5 AND 17
    GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(v.visit_start_date), MONTH(v.visit_start_date), 1)
),
steroid_ingredients AS (
    SELECT concept_id
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
      AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('prednisone','prednisolone','dexamethasone','methylprednisolone','hydrocortisone')
),
oral_steroid_concepts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN steroid_ingredients si ON si.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
    WHERE c.domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
      AND LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%oral%'
      AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%topical%'
      AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%ophthalmic%'
      AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%otic%'
      AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%nasal%'
      AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%injection%'
),
steroid_bursts AS (
    SELECT
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date), MONTH(de.drug_exposure_start_date), 1) AS month_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT de.drug_exposure_id) AS oral_steroid_bursts,
        COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS oral_steroid_patients
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN params p ON de.drug_exposure_start_date >= p.start_date AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < p.end_date
    JOIN asthma_patients ap ON ap.person_id = de.person_id
    JOIN omop.person per ON per.person_id = de.person_id
    WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM oral_steroid_concepts)
      AND (de.days_supply IS NULL OR de.days_supply BETWEEN 1 AND 14)
      AND (YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) - per.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 5 AND 17
    GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date), MONTH(de.drug_exposure_start_date), 1)
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(7), m.month_start, 120) AS month,
    COALESCE(e.ed_exacerbation_visits, 0) AS ed_exacerbation_visits,
    COALESCE(e.ed_exacerbation_patients, 0) AS ed_exacerbation_patients,
    COALESCE(s.oral_steroid_bursts, 0) AS oral_steroid_bursts,
    COALESCE(s.oral_steroid_patients, 0) AS oral_steroid_patients
FROM (
    SELECT DATEADD(month, v.number, (SELECT start_date FROM params)) AS month_start
    FROM master..spt_values v
    WHERE v.type = 'P' AND v.number BETWEEN 0 AND 35
) m
LEFT JOIN ed_exac e ON e.month_start = m.month_start
LEFT JOIN steroid_bursts s ON s.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT CAST('2023-07-01' AS date) AS start_date, CAST('2026-07-01' AS date) AS end_date
),
asthma_concepts AS (

    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 317009
),
child_asthma_visits AS (
    SELECT v.visit_concept_id, vc.concept_name AS visit_concept_name, v.visit_source_value, COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_occurrence_id) AS n
    FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
    JOIN params p ON v.visit_start_date >= p.start_date AND v.visit_start_date < p.end_date
    JOIN omop.person per ON per.person_id = v.person_id
    JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id = v.visit_occurrence_id
    LEFT JOIN omop.concept vc ON vc.concept_id = v.visit_concept_id
    WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM asthma_concepts)

    GROUP BY v.visit_concept_id, vc.concept_name, v.visit_source_value
)

No — not clearly, based on the OMOP data I queried.

**ED visits for asthma exacerbation**
- I found **0 ED-coded asthma/exacerbation visits** for children 5–17 in 2023–2025.
- The visit table in this period appears to have **Office, Outpatient, Inpatient, and unmapped visits**, but no `Emergency Room Visit`/ED-coded rows for this cohort.
- So ED seasonality **cannot be assessed** from the available visit coding.

**Oral steroid bursts**
- Defined as oral prednisone/prednisolone/dexamethasone/methylprednisolone/hydrocortisone, `days_supply` 1–14, among children 5–17 with asthma.
- Counts did **not show reproducible fall and spring peaks**.
- Seasonal mean monthly bursts across 2023–2025:

| Season | Mean monthly bursts |
|---|---:|
| Spring | 858 |
| Summer | 826 |
| Fall | 727 |
| Winter | 928 |

**Interpretation**
- Oral steroid bursts were highest on average in **winter**, not fall/spring.
- There was a **fall bump in 2024** around Sep–Oct, but it was not consistent across years.
- 2025 counts drop sharply late in the year, so data completeness or capture changes may affect the trend.

Bottom line: **No consistent fall + spring peak pattern is supported here; ED data are not usable for that question as coded, and steroid bursts show more winter predominance than fall/spring seasonality.**
